info.name: Coinbase Business Checkouts Webhooks API
info.description:
Current-generation REST API replacing the legacy Charges API for creating and managing single-use hosted payment checkouts. Merchants create a checkout object with a fixed USDC amount on the Base network; customers complete payment through a hosted URL. Uses JWT bearer token authentication and idempotency keys. Provides simplified status model and webhook events for the payment lifecycle.
